title: Productize physics capture and substep replay
requires: CUDA reference device; public API and Gallery test harness
scope: Turn the retained Gallery debug capture into a backend-neutral, versioned capture and replay path that can reproduce a selected substep without driver-private access.
acceptance: Specify capture provenance, resource identity, partial-data behavior and schema versioning; use the public API or common support code rather than driver internals.
Round-trip the archived over-top rigid state and reproduce its 1/240-second check on current CUDA with focused negative and compatibility tests.
evidence: PASS: v5 schema records provenance, stable resource identities, exact PmStepInfo, bounded-history completeness and explicit body-subset policy; v3/v4 remain diagnostic-readable; docs/GALLERY.md and docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-10-physics-capture-replay.json
PASS: exact archived frame 2073 state round-trips; compatibility, truncation, duplicate/unknown identity and partial-policy tests pass; parallel-mater-physics-debug-tests

PASS: end-to-end three-frame CUDA Gallery capture on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU wrote six identities and history_complete 1; tracked in docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-10-physics-capture-replay.json

RESULT: public API replay ran 448 substeps at 1/240 s and cleared the top; unchanged current solver reproduced F6-11 quality failures (7.70263 rad/s abrupt loss, 0.127161 m gear overlap); no solver, fixture, or golden changes included
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p 'test_*.py' -v passed 25/25; evidence pins capture and retained candidate hashes
